Name: D_1
dialogue: Who could be notifying me at this time of night?

Name: D_2
dialogue: Huh, she found something for me?!

Name: D_3
dialogue: Nyra must of gotten it before the power went off, but how is it here? She won't be able to function until tomorrow morning when her boot-up completes.

Name: D_4
dialogue: She actually saved job posts in case something happened. She actually utilized good computer habits.

Name: D_5
dialogue: I am so proud of her. My creation went from selling out my identity online to backing up basic information more than the average university student.

Name: D_6
dialogue: Maybe there is a chance her memory isn't completely gone. If she knows how to back up information like this, she might do the same for her own memory.

Name: D_7
dialogue: Haha! If that is the case, I will buy her a new PC the moment I pay off this rent.

Name: D_8
dialogue: Alright! Time to get this job!

Name: D_9
dialogue: I can't let Nyra's last action be in vain.
